parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: BehaviorType
parameters.description:
The type of the web fallback behavior.

0: The specified content is returned.

1: Redirect to the specified page.

parameters.name: BodyEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding type.

0: plain text

1: JSON text

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule.

0: disable

1: enable

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the concurrency rule.

parameters.name: MaxConcurrency
parameters.description: The maximum number of concurrent requests.

parameters.name: ResponseContentBody
parameters.description: The HTTP text to be returned.

parameters.name: ResponseRedirectUrl
parameters.description: The URL to be redirected to.
